turns.user_utterance: I was trying to purchase something at the store today and my card has been declined.  Why has this happened?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—card payments can be declined for a few different reasons. Was the decline happening in-store by tapping/swiping/chipping, and do you see any error code/message on your side (or did it just say “declined”)?

turns.user_utterance: It was a chip transaction – it just said “declined,” no error code or extra message.
turns.assistant_response:
Thanks—if a chip transaction simply says “declined” with no error code, the most common reason is that the card payment was rejected by the merchant terminal (for example: insufficient funds, merchant not allowed, or a temporary security/fraud check). 

Can you confirm: (1) do you have enough available balance, and (2) have you used this card successfully at other places today or is it declining everywhere?
